from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentRecord(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single legal document relevant to the task."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action (案由) stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentRecord]
